description: Use Tapp's first-class platform-neutral UI Map: evidence-grounded screen states, semantic controls, transitions, platform variants, provenance, and task/contract coverage hooks. QA runs create capture-local ui-map.json automatically. `read` returns one; `build` deterministically builds/merges a repository map from OCQA evidence; `diff` reports additions and absences without calling shallow-run absence a regression unless comparableFullSweep is explicitly true. No AI is used.

afterPath.description: Repo-relative current UI Map for diff

beforePath.description: Repo-relative baseline UI Map for diff

captureId.description: Read/build from this Tapp capture's ocqa-markers.txt/ui-map.json

comparableFullSweep.description: Diff: only enable when both runs had comparable target/config/action budget; permits lost-reachability classification

mapPath.description: Repo-relative UI Map path for read, or build output (default .tapp/ui-map.json)

markersPath.description: Repo-relative OCQA markers path for build when captureId is not supplied

replace.description: Build: replace rather than merge existing repository map

target.description: Bundle id, Android app id, or owned URL recorded as map provenance

name: tapp_ui_map
title: Build, inspect, or diff the Tapp UI Map
